text_block_list.text:
—Oguri Cap is trembling.
It seems that even she gets nervous before facing her close friend.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I will... believe in the me...
that you and everyone else believe in.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“—You're here, Oguri!
I've been waitin' for ya.”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama.
There is something I want to tell you today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's unusual.
Alright, out with it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—I am your rival.
And I will defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, you're really fired up now!
That's what I've been waitin' for, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Come at me with everything you've got! Don't expect any comfort from me tonight even if you're crying in your room!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And if someone is to comfort her tonight...
I'm sure that is my role to play.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Haha, that's hilarious! Heh, now that's what I'm talkin' about!"
